projects.name: Cortex 2
projects.quote: Cortex 2 supports the development of both vehicle and humanoid robot autonomy software and will ramp further over the rest of the year to ensure we have sufficient compute resources.

projects.name: Cortex 1
projects.quote: We have more than doubled our onsite compute in Texas (in terms of MW of compute) during the first half of 2026.

projects.name: Optimus production lines at Fremont Factory
projects.quote: We have decommissioned the manufacturing lines for Models S & X at our Fremont Factory and are installing the first-generation lines for Optimus, where we expect to start production soon.

projects.name: Optimus factory at Gigafactory Texas
projects.quote: Additionally, we continued site development at Gigafactory Texas with building construction now in full swing.

projects.name: Megafactory Texas
projects.quote: Megafactory Texas is nearing completion, with start of production planned for this year.
